```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(baseballr)
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
library(ggplot2)
```


```{r}
# all challenges
challenges_df <- read_csv("taptochallenge_challenges_2026_R.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    challenge_category = case_when(
      Role == "batter" & Result == TRUE ~ "Successful Batter Challenge",
      Role == "batter" & Result == FALSE ~ "Unsuccessful Batter Challenge",
      Role %in% c("catcher", "pitcher") & Result == TRUE ~ "Successful Pitcher/Catcher Challenge",
      Role %in% c("catcher", "pitcher") & Result == FALSE ~ "Unsuccessful Pitcher/Catcher Challenge",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    category_type = "Executed Challenge",
    # Clean player name format to match Statcast "Last, First" -> "First Last" or vice versa
    player_name_clean = str_trim(Player)
  )

# missed opportunities
missed_df <- read_csv("taptochallenge_missed_2026_R.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    challenge_category = case_when(
      Role == "Batter" ~ "Missed Opportunity - Batter",
      Role == "Pitcher/Catcher" ~ "Missed Opportunity - Pitcher/Catcher",
      TRUE ~ "Missed Opportunity - Other"
    ),
    category_type = "Missed Opportunity",
    player_name_clean = str_trim(Player)
  )

# missed opportunities out of challenges
out_of_challenges_df <- read_csv("taptochallenge_out_of_challenges_2026_R.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    challenge_category = case_when(
      Role == "Batter" ~ "Out of Challenges - Batter",
      Role == "Pitcher/Catcher" ~ "Out of Challenges - Pitcher/Catcher",
      TRUE ~ "Out of Challenges - Other"
    ),
    category_type = "Out of Challenges",
    player_name_clean = str_trim(Player)
  )

# combine?
master_strategy_df <- bind_rows(challenges_df, missed_df, out_of_challenges_df)
```

```{r}
# RE24/run expectancy summary table
master_strategy_summary <- master_strategy_df %>%
  group_by(category_type, challenge_category) %>%
  summarize(
    total_events = n(),
    mean_potential_re_delta = mean(`Potential Run Expectancy delta if overturned`, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_net_wpa = if("Net WPA" %in% names(.)) mean(`Net WPA`, na.rm = TRUE) else NA,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
# regression model
model1 <- lm(`Potential Run Expectancy delta if overturned` ~ category_type + `Call LI`, data = master_strategy_df)
summary(model1)
```

```{r}
model2 <- glm(Result ~ `Dist (in.)` + `xStr%` + `Call LI`,
              data = master_strategy_df %>% filter(!is.na(Result)),
              family = binomial(link = "logit"))
summary(model2)
```

```{r}
set.seed(1234)
n_sims <- 1000

sim_strategy_re <- function(df, sims = n_sims) {
  df %>%
    filter(!is.na(`Potential Run Expectancy delta if overturned`)) %>%
    slice(rep(1:n(), each = sims)) %>%
    mutate(
      sim_re_change = rnorm(n(), mean = `Potential Run Expectancy delta if overturned`, sd = 0.05),
      sim_re_change = pmax(sim_re_change, 0)
    )
}

sim_strategy_results <- sim_strategy_re(master_strategy_df)
```

```{r}
# viz 1: density plot for sim
mc_plot <- ggplot(sim_strategy_results, aes(x = sim_re_change, fill = category_type)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5, color = "navy", linewidth = 0.4) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  labs(title = "Monte Carlo Sim: Potential Run Expectancy change by stratefy state",
       subtitle = "Simulated variance across 1000 iterations",
       x = "Simulated potential RE Change", y = "Density",
       fill = "Strategy state") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2")
```

```{r}
install.packages("rsconnect")
library(rsconnect)
library(shiny)

# app ui
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("ABS Challenge Strategy & RE24 Impact Dashboard"),
  
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput("selected_team", "Select Team:",
                  choices = c("All Teams" = "ALL", sort(unique(master_strategy_df$Team[!is.na(master_strategy_df$Team)])))),
      
      # 2. Player-level filter (dynamically updates based on selected team)
      uiOutput("player_select_ui"),
      
      # 3. Metric selector
      selectInput("metric_choice", "Select Strategic Metric:",
                  choices = c("Potential Run Expectancy Delta" = "Potential Run Expectancy delta if overturned", 
                              "Leverage Index (Call LI)" = "Call LI", 
                              "Distance from Zone (in.)" = "Dist (in.)")),
      
      helpText("Filter by team and individual player to examine run expectancy swings and decision states.")
    ),
    
    mainPanel(
      tabsetPanel(
        tabPanel("Strategy comparison panel",
                 plotOutput("team_plot"),
                 tags$hr(),
                 p("Comparing Run Expectancy values and leverage across executed challenges, missed opportunities, and out of challenge states.")),
        
        tabPanel("Monte Carlo Simulation",
                 plotOutput("sim_tab_plot"),
                 tags$hr(),
                 p("Distribution of simulated Run Expectancy swings.")),
        
        tabPanel("Strategy data table",
                 tableOutput("team_table"))
      )
    )
  )
)

# --- SHINY APP SERVER ---
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  # Dynamic UI for player selection based on selected team
  output$player_select_ui <- renderUI({
    df <- master_strategy_df
    if (!is.null(input$selected_team) && input$selected_team != "ALL") {
      df <- df %>% filter(Team == input$selected_team)
    }
    player_choices <- c("All Players" = "ALL", sort(unique(df$Player[!is.na(df$Player)])))
    
    selectInput("selected_player", "Select player:", choices = player_choices, selected = "ALL")
  })
  
  # Reactive dataset filtered by both team and player selections
  filtered_data <- reactive({
    df <- master_strategy_df
    
    if(!is.null(input$selected_team) && input$selected_team != "ALL") {
      df <- df %>% filter(Team == input$selected_team)
    }
    
    if(!is.null(input$selected_player) && input$selected_player != "ALL") {
      df <- df %>% filter(Player == input$selected_player)
    }
    
    df
  })
  
  # IMPROVED VISUALIZATION: Violin Plot with Mean Points and Boxplots
  output$team_plot <- renderPlot({
    df <- filtered_data()
    if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
    metric_sym <- sym(input$metric_choice)
    
    title_text <- if (!is.null(input$selected_player) && input$selected_player != "ALL") {
      paste("Strategic Breakdown for", input$selected_player)
    } else if (!is.null(input$selected_team) && input$selected_team != "ALL") {
      paste("Strategic Breakdown for Team:", input$selected_team)
    } else {
      "Strategic Breakdown: League-Wide"
    }
    
    ggplot(df, aes(x = category_type, y = !!metric_sym, fill = category_type)) +
      geom_violin(alpha = 0.6, trim = FALSE, scale = "width") +
      geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, color = "black", alpha = 0.8, outlier.shape = NA) +
      stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 21, size = 3, fill = "white", color = "black") +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
      labs(title = title_text,
           subtitle = paste("Distribution of", input$metric_choice, "(White dot = Mean)"),
           x = "Strategic Decision State", y = input$metric_choice) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 15, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
            legend.position = "none") +
      scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Pastel2")
  })
  
  # Monte Carlo Simulation Plot
  output$sim_tab_plot <- renderPlot({
    df <- filtered_data()
    if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
    
    set.seed(1234)
    sim_df <- df %>%
      filter(!is.na(`Potential Run Expectancy delta if overturned`)) %>%
      slice(rep(1:n(), each = 50)) %>%
      mutate(
        sim_re = rnorm(n(), mean = `Potential Run Expectancy delta if overturned`, sd = 0.04)
      )
    
    ggplot(sim_df, aes(x = sim_re, fill = category_type)) +
      geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
      labs(title = "Monte Carlo simulation spread",
           subtitle = "Simulated Run Expectancy change distribution",
           x = "Simulated potential RE change", y = "Density",
           fill = "Strategy state") +
      scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2")
  })
  
# summary table
  output$team_table <- renderTable({
    df <- filtered_data()
    if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
    
    if (!is.null(input$selected_player) && input$selected_player != "ALL") {
      # player-level table
      df %>%
        group_by(Player, category_type, challenge_category) %>%
        summarize(
          Total_Events = n(),
          Mean_RE_Delta = mean(`Potential Run Expectancy delta if overturned`, na.rm = TRUE),
          Mean_Leverage = mean(`Call LI`, na.rm = TRUE),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        filter(Total_Events >= 3) %>%
        arrange(desc(Mean_Leverage))
      
    } else if (!is.null(input$selected_team) && input$selected_team != "ALL") {
      # team-roster table
      df %>%
        group_by(Player, category_type) %>%
        summarize(
          Total_Events = n(),
          Mean_RE_Delta = mean(`Potential Run Expectancy delta if overturned`, na.rm = TRUE),
          Mean_Leverage = mean(`Call LI`, na.rm = TRUE),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        group_by(Player) %>%
        mutate(Player_Total_Events = sum(Total_Events)) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        filter(Player_Total_Events > 3) %>%
        select(-Player_Total_Events) %>%
        pivot_wider(
          names_from = category_type,
          values_from = c(Total_Events, Mean_RE_Delta),
          values_fill = 0
        ) %>%
        arrange(desc(Mean_Leverage))
      
    } else {
      # LEAGUE-WIDE TEAM LEADERBOARD SUMMARY TABLE (Filtered for teams with > 3 total events)
      df %>%
        group_by(Team, category_type) %>%
        summarize(
          Total_Events = n(),
          Mean_RE_Delta = mean(`Potential Run Expectancy delta if overturned`, na.rm = TRUE),
          Mean_Leverage = mean(`Call LI`, na.rm = TRUE),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        group_by(Team) %>%
        mutate(Team_Total_Events = sum(Total_Events)) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        filter(Team_Total_Events > 3) %>%
        select(-Team_Total_Events) %>%
        pivot_wider(
          names_from = category_type,
          values_from = c(Total_Events, Mean_RE_Delta),
          values_fill = 0
        ) %>%
        arrange(desc(Mean_Leverage))
    }
  }, striped = TRUE, hover = TRUE, bordered = TRUE)
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```
